name: RED eTap shift/brake control pair
weight_description: Published pair reference for the original eleven-speed RED eTap rim-brake controls: 260 g for the complete left/right pair, including their coin-cell batteries. BikeRumor explicitly lists 260 g/pair; the catalogue does not double an individual-lever figure. Separate Blips and brake calipers are not included; brake-cable and housing inclusion is not stated.
